title: Scientist
blurb: Scientists ask questions about the world and search for answers through careful experiments - just like George Washington Carver did with plants.

title: Engineer
blurb: Engineers design and build things that solve problems - like Granville Woods did with his railway inventions.

title: Doctor
blurb: Doctors take care of people and help keep them healthy - just like Dr. Charles Drew, who found ways to save lives through medicine.

title: Teacher
blurb: Teachers help others learn and grow - just like Mary McLeod Bethune, who built a school so every child could get an education.

title: Artist
blurb: Artists tell stories through color, shape, and imagination - like Jacob Lawrence, who painted powerful pictures of history.

title: Astronaut
blurb: Astronauts explore space and discover new things beyond our planet - just like Mae Jemison did aboard the Space Shuttle.

title: Entrepreneur
blurb: Entrepreneurs start businesses and build communities around their ideas - like O.W. Gurley, who helped build Greenwood.

title: Lawyer
blurb: Lawyers study the rules that keep communities fair, and work hard to make sure everyone is treated justly.

title: Architect
blurb: Architects design buildings that can last for centuries - like the builders who designed the stone city of Great Zimbabwe.

title: Computer Programmer
blurb: Programmers write instructions that power apps, games, and websites - creating brand new tools for the future.

title: Journalist
blurb: Journalists research and share true stories with the world - just like Frederick Douglass, who published his own newspaper.

title: Historian
blurb: Historians study and share the stories of the past so they are never forgotten - a tradition as old as the griots of West Africa.

title: Filmmaker
blurb: Filmmakers bring stories to life on screen, sharing ideas and adventures with audiences everywhere.

title: Musician
blurb: Musicians create the songs and rhythms that move us - just like Louis Armstrong did with his joyful trumpet.
